import html from typing import Final # Predefined template for blog posts. Adjust as needed. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML for the blog post. Raises ------ ValueError If either heading or content is empty after stripping whitespace. """ # Validate input if not heading.strip(): raise ValueError("Heading must not be empty.") if not content.strip(): raise ValueError("Content must not be empty.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in content and escape HTML safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format using the predefined template formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted.strip()
